# Main component — TrailCurrent Power Dashboard.
#
# Everything the GUI needs lives in UI/. Two kinds of file are in there:
#
#   generated by EEZ Studio (Ctrl+B)  screens.c  styles.c  images.c  ui.c
#                                     ui_font_*.c  ui_image_*.c  and the headers
#   written by hand                   actions.c  vars.c  dash_data.c
#
# Both kinds are swept up by the globs below, so an EEZ Studio export drops
# straight into UI/ and needs no CMake edit — including when it adds a new font
# or bitmap, which is the usual reason a build suddenly fails to link
# (undefined reference to ui_font_<name> / img_<name>).
#
# The generated core files only exist AFTER the first export. Until then the
# globs come back empty and the __has_include guards in main.c / actions.c
# collapse the UI references, so the project still builds.

# CONFIGURE_DEPENDS is essential here, not a nicety. A plain file(GLOB) is
# evaluated once at CMake configure time. On a tree where the export has not run
# yet the globs come back empty, CMake caches that, and every later
# `idf.py build` happily links a firmware with NO generated UI in it — no error,
# no warning, "Project build complete". CONFIGURE_DEPENDS makes the build system
# re-check the globs and reconfigure when the matching set changes, so a fresh
# export is picked up on the next build.
#
# It cannot be passed unconditionally, though: ESP-IDF evaluates every component
# CMakeLists.txt in CMake *script* mode first, to collect REQUIRES before the
# real configure pass, and CONFIGURE_DEPENDS is illegal there —
# "CONFIGURE_DEPENDS is invalid for script and find package modes". So it is
# only added on the real pass; the script pass just needs the glob to parse.
if(CMAKE_SCRIPT_MODE_FILE)
    set(UI_GLOB_MODE "")
else()
    set(UI_GLOB_MODE CONFIGURE_DEPENDS)
endif()

file(GLOB UI_GENERATED ${UI_GLOB_MODE}
     "UI/screens.c" "UI/styles.c" "UI/images.c" "UI/ui.c")
file(GLOB UI_FONTS  ${UI_GLOB_MODE} "UI/ui_font_*.c")
file(GLOB UI_IMAGES ${UI_GLOB_MODE} "UI/ui_image_*.c")

# Fail loudly rather than silently shipping a UI-less binary: if the export is
# present (ui.h exists) then its four core .c files must have been globbed.
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/UI/ui.h" AND NOT UI_GENERATED)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "main/UI/ui.h exists but no generated sources were found. "
        "Run `idf.py reconfigure` after an EEZ Studio export.")
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        main.c
        # Hand-written, inside UI/ because the EEZ Studio simulator only
        # compiles what is in the export folder.
        UI/actions.c
        UI/vars.c
        UI/dash_data.c
        # Wi-Fi port. The _sim backend is inside an EEZ_LVGL_SIMULATOR guard
        # and compiles to an empty translation unit on the device; the _esp
        # backend lives outside UI/ so the simulator never even copies it.
        UI/broker_cfg_sim.c
        UI/wifi_port_common.c
        UI/wifi_port_sim.c
        wifi_port_esp.c
        broker_cfg_esp.c
        mqtt_source.c
        ${UI_GENERATED}
        ${UI_FONTS}
        ${UI_IMAGES}
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        .
        UI
    REQUIRES
        # Waveshare BSP — bundles esp_lcd_ek79007 (MIPI-DSI panel),
        # esp_lcd_touch_gt911 and esp_lvgl_port.
        waveshare__esp32_p4_wifi6_touch_lcd_7b
        espressif__esp_lvgl_port
        lvgl__lvgl
        nvs_flash
        esp_event
        esp_timer
        esp_netif
        esp_wifi
        mqtt
        json
)

# LVGL's headers are included as <lvgl.h> rather than <lvgl/lvgl.h>, matching
# the lvglInclude setting in the .eez-project.
idf_component_get_property(LVGL_LIB lvgl__lvgl COMPONENT_LIB)
if(LVGL_LIB)
    target_compile_options(${LVGL_LIB} PRIVATE -DLV_LVGL_H_INCLUDE_SIMPLE)
endif()
